description: District Secretariat - Galle - Annual Duruthu Maha Procession of Pilana Purana Sri Maha Temple in the Akmeemana, Galle District
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the schedule for a religious procession (Annual Duruthu Maha Procession) under the authority of the Pilgrimages Ordinance (Cap.175). It references a previous gazette notification and is made in accordance with regulations under Section 2 of this ordinance. The content primarily deals with the legal/regulatory framework governing pilgrimages and religious processions, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette.
